en.template: Help our Indian family plan a Dubai move for {date}, with children aged {children}, workplace {office}, salary {salary} and housing allowance {allowance}. Start with Al Barsha 1, compare Discovery Gardens for value and The Greens for the work commute. We need {bedrooms}, {school}, {transport}, {cheques} and {cash}. Separate dated ads from confirmed availability. Confirm school and bus feasibility, test actual journeys, itemise rent, cooling, utilities, deposits and signing cash, and list unresolved terms. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing documents, submitting forms or making a payment.

phases.title: Read Dubai’s tenancy law, rent-increase rules, utility and cooling fees and the school directory, and collect dated listings
phases.note: Rent rules, deposits, utilities, cooling, seven areas’ listings and schools
phases.judgment: The school directory only says “Indian curriculum”, so it did not relabel any school as CBSE. It also left one school off the shortlist because search results disagreed on CBSE versus ICSE.

phases.title: Build the guide and cost models with the arithmetic shown
phases.note: Three shortlisted homes compared on true yearly cost and cash needed at keys
phases.judgment: It marked every running cost without an official price as its own assumption, and showed that the cheaper rent can need more cash on arrival: Discovery Gardens AED 55,682.50 against Al Barsha AED 22,028.15, because its advertised payment is two cheques instead of twelve.

phases.title: Independent check of the figures and claims, plus desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The reviewer matched all 69 cost figures (121 checks passed) and still listed what it could not support: the guide stated the payment-method rule and some registration steps more specifically than its source list records. School seats and CBSE status stay unconfirmed.

workers: Read Dubai’s tenancy laws, the rent-increase rules and the registration, electricity-deposit and cooling fee pages
Collected seven asking-rent examples across the requested areas and checked three Indian-curriculum schools in the official school directory
Recomputed every money figure independently and checked the guide’s claims against its sources
